_readme: Every factor used by the CBAM calculator and cost model. Values marked ILLUSTRATIVE are demo placeholders: replace them with the official figure before quoting numbers publicly.

natural_gas.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Vol. 2 Ch. 2, Table 2.2: natural gas default CO2 factor 56,100 kg/TJ
natural_gas.verify: Use the installation's monitoring plan factor where one exists

electrodes.source: EU MRR (Implementing Reg. 2018/2066) Annex VI standard factor for EAF electrodes
electrodes.verify: Check the current MRR / CBAM implementing regulation value

charge_carbon.source: EU MRR (Implementing Reg. 2018/2066) Annex VI standard factor for EAF charge carbon
charge_carbon.verify: Check the current MRR / CBAM implementing regulation value

pig_iron.source: ILLUSTRATIVE: supplier-declared embedded emissions of purchased pig iron
pig_iron.verify: In production this comes from the supplier's own CarbonPass passport (precursor chaining)

TR.verify: Replace with the official national grid factor / CBAM default for electricity

IN.verify: Replace with the CEA CO2 Baseline Database figure

72083900.description: Hot-rolled flat products of iron or non-alloy steel (CN 7208 39 00)
72083900.verify: Replace with the EU default values implementing regulation figure for this CN code and country of origin

chargeable_scope._source: Reg. (EU) 2023/956 Annex II: indirect emissions are covered for cement and fertilisers only. Verify before quoting.

default_markup._source: Aither / Alalea guidance: 10% markup on default values in 2026
default_markup._note: Later years are held at the 2026 level in this model (conservative); verify the official schedule

cbam_factor._source: Phase-out of free allocation for CBAM sectors (EU ETS Directive Art. 10a(1a)); CBAM obligation = 1 minus the free-allocation share

eu_ets_price_eur.source: ASSUMPTION: adjustable in the app's cost model

eaf_hot_rolled._source: ILLUSTRATIVE plausibility ranges for scrap-based EAF + hot rolling
